description: Emails the customer a single-use secure link (valid 7 days) to Libertas's bind page, where they review the chosen option, see the carrier's name, and submit their request; a licensed agent completes the purchase. Uses the email address already on the quote and reports whether it was sent; no text message is sent. Useful when the customer wants to finish later or on another device. Nothing is purchased by this call.

option_id.description: Selected option to include on the secure bind-request page.

quote_id.description: Quote whose saved customer email will receive the secure link.

name: get_bind_link

outputSchema.description: Secure, single-use bind hand-off link — the only place a real carrier name appears.

title: Email a secure bind link
